fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.description: Full title of the book, e.g. "The Abrahamic Promise".

fields.name: author
fields.label: Author
fields.description: Who wrote the book, e.g. "Prof. Mercer" or "Dr. Charles Vance".

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: One or two sentences shown on the book card, e.g. "The grammatical-historical method outlined with practical textual analysis exercises."

fields.name: abstract
fields.label: Scholarly Abstract
fields.description: Scholarly abstract or comprehensive summary shown in the "Abstract" drawer on the book page, e.g. "A critical survey of Byzantine text families and their transmission history."

fields.name: format
fields.label: Format / Badge
fields.description: Pick the book's format, e.g. 'Monograph'. To add or remove options, open the 'Book Formats' collection in the left sidebar and create or delete a format.

fields.name: subject
fields.label: Subject
fields.description: Pick the book's subject, e.g. 'Hermeneutics'. To add or remove options, open the 'Book Subjects' collection in the left sidebar and create or delete a subject.

fields.name: coverImage
fields.label: Cover Image
fields.description: Front cover shown on book cards and the detail page — upload a portrait (3:4) image or paste an image URL, e.g. '/uploads/abrahamic-promise-cover.jpg'.

fields.name: featured
fields.label: Featured
fields.description: Set to 'yes' to show this book in 'Featured Books & Magazines' on the home page.

fields.name: featuredPosition
fields.label: Home Page Position
fields.description: Only needed when Featured is 'yes', e.g. '1'. 1 = left card, 2 = right card. Position 1 also becomes the spotlight at the top of the Books page. If two featured books claim one position, the first alphabetically wins.

fields.name: pdfFile
fields.label: Book Monograph PDF
fields.description: Upload or select a PDF monograph file for digital download, e.g. '/uploads/hermeneutics.pdf'.

fields.name: body
fields.label: Book Overview / Abstract
fields.description: The full overview text — headings, paragraphs and quotes are rendered on the book detail page, e.g. a chapter-by-chapter synopsis.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Format Name
fields.description: Shown as the badge on book cards, e.g. 'Monograph'.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Subject Name
fields.description: Shown on book cards and in the subject filter, e.g. 'Hermeneutics'.

fields.name: division
fields.label: Biblical Division
fields.description: Pick the lesson's division. To add or remove options, open the 'Biblical Divisions' collection in the left sidebar and create or delete a division.

fields.name: readTime
fields.label: Read Time
fields.description: Shown on the home-page featured card, e.g. '45 mins read' (optional).

fields.name: publishedDate
fields.label: Published Date
fields.description: Used only for tie-breaking: when two featured lessons claim the same home-page position, the one with the newer Published Date wins.

fields.name: featured
fields.label: Featured on Home Page
fields.description: Set to 'Yes' to show this lesson in the 'Featured Bible Lessons' section on the home page.

fields.name: featuredPosition
fields.label: Home Page Position
fields.description: Only needed when 'Featured on Home Page' is Yes. 1 = left card, 2 = middle card, 3 = right card. The position-1 lesson also becomes the spotlight at the top of the Lessons page. If another featured lesson already uses this position, the one with the newer Published Date takes the slot — afterwards set the old lesson's 'Featured on Home Page' back to 'No' to keep things tidy.

fields.name: image
fields.label: Lesson Cover Image
fields.description: Optional cover image for this expository lesson

fields.name: pdfFile
fields.label: Lesson PDF
fields.description: Upload or select the lesson PDF. The "Read Lesson" button opens it in a new browser tab.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Genre Name
fields.description: Shown on scripture reference cards and filters, e.g. 'Prophecy'.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Division Name
fields.description: Shown as the category tag on lesson cards, e.g. 'Pentateuch'.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.description: The issue theme shown on the card and detail page, e.g. "Ecclesiology".

fields.name: issue
fields.label: Issue
fields.description: The display label for this issue, e.g. "Summer 2024".

fields.name: season
fields.label: Season / Issue
fields.description: Pick the season — powers the 'All Issues' filter on the Magazines page.

fields.name: year
fields.label: Year
fields.description: Type the publication year, e.g. '2024'. Whatever you enter automatically appears in the website's Year filter.

fields.name: topic
fields.label: Topic
fields.description: Pick the magazine topic. To add or remove options, open the 'Magazine Topics' collection in the left sidebar and create or delete a topic.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: Short summary shown on the magazine card, e.g. "The nature and mission of the church".

fields.name: coverImage
fields.label: Cover Image
fields.description: Cover shown on cards and the detail page — portrait images (e.g. 3:4) work best.

fields.name: publishDate
fields.label: Publish Date
fields.description: e.g. "June 2024". When two featured issues claim the same home-page position, the one with the newer Publish Date wins.

fields.name: articlesCount
fields.label: Articles Count
fields.description: Number of articles in this issue, e.g. 8 — shown in the issue stats.

fields.name: contributorsCount
fields.label: Contributors Count
fields.description: Number of contributors, e.g. 5 — shown in the issue stats.

fields.name: pagesCount
fields.label: Pages Count
fields.description: Total page count, e.g. 64 — shown in the issue stats.

fields.name: badge
fields.label: Badge / Tag
fields.description: Optional tag on the card, e.g. "Latest Issue". Issues marked "Previous Issue" are hidden from the archive grid — use it for the featured hero issue.

fields.name: featured
fields.label: Featured on Home Page
fields.description: Set to 'Yes' to show this issue in 'Featured Books & Magazines' on the home page.

fields.name: featuredPosition
fields.label: Home Page Position
fields.description: Only needed when Featured is 'Yes'. 1 = left card, 2 = right card. Position 1 also becomes the hero at the top of the Magazines page. If two featured issues claim one position, the one with the newer Publish Date wins.

fields.name: pdfFile
fields.label: Magazine Issue PDF
fields.description: Upload or select a PDF magazine issue file for digital download

fields.name: body
fields.label: Issue Content / Overview
fields.description: The editorial overview rendered on the issue detail page — headings, paragraphs, quotes and lists all display.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Topic Name
fields.description: Shown on magazine cards and in the Topic filter, e.g. 'Systematic Theology'.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.description: Short descriptive title, e.g. "The Shema and the Greatest Commandment".

fields.name: scripture
fields.label: Scripture Reference
fields.description: Book and verse range, e.g. "Deuteronomy 6:4-9" or "Matthew 1:22-23".

fields.name: category
fields.label: Category
fields.description: Theological grouping shown on the card, e.g. "Torah Law", "Prophecy Fulfillment", or "Messianic Prophecy".

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: One or two sentences summarizing the reference, e.g. "Cross-references the Psalm's imagery of suffering with the crucifixion accounts in the Gospels."

fields.name: image
fields.label: Reference Image
fields.description: Optional cover image shown on the reference detail page.

fields.name: author
fields.label: Author / Scholar
fields.description: Who wrote the commentary, e.g. "Dr. Charles Vance".

fields.name: testament
fields.label: Testament
fields.description: Which testament the scripture comes from.

fields.name: genre
fields.label: Biblical Genre
fields.description: Pick the genre. To add or remove options, open the 'Biblical Genres' collection in the left sidebar and create or delete a genre.

fields.name: addedDate
fields.label: Date Added
fields.description: The two references with the newest Date Added are shown in 'Latest Bible References' on the home page.

fields.name: featured
fields.label: Featured Scholarly Reference
fields.description: Set to 'Yes' to showcase this reference in the highlighted spotlight at the top of the Scripture References page. Only one should be 'Yes' — if several are marked, the one with the newest Date Added is used.

fields.name: tags
fields.label: Tags
fields.description: Small labels shown as chips on the card, e.g. "Prophecy", "Atonement", "Gospel Parallel". Add as many as you like.

fields.name: crossReferences
fields.label: Cross References
fields.description: Optional list shown in the home-page featured spotlight, e.g. "Romans 4, Galatians 3, Hebrews 11".

fields.name: body
fields.label: Commentary Body
fields.description: The full commentary text — headings, paragraphs, quotes and lists are all rendered on the reference detail page.

fields.name: series
fields.label: Series Tag
fields.description: Pick the video's series. To add or remove options, open the 'Video Series' collection in the left sidebar and create or delete a series.

fields.name: speaker
fields.label: Speaker
fields.description: Pick the speaker. To add or remove names, open the 'Speakers' collection in the left sidebar.

fields.name: recordedDate
fields.label: Recorded Date
fields.description: Pick the date this lecture was recorded. When two featured videos claim the same home-page position, the one with the newer Recorded Date wins.

fields.name: videoUrl
fields.label: YouTube Video URL
fields.description: Paste a YouTube link (e.g. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=... or https://youtu.be/...)

fields.name: featured
fields.label: Featured on Home Page
fields.description: Set to 'Yes' to show this video in the 'Featured Bible Videos' section on the home page.

fields.name: featuredPosition
fields.label: Home Page Position
fields.description: Only needed when 'Featured on Home Page' is Yes. 1 = left card, 2 = middle card, 3 = right card. If another featured video already uses this position, the one with the newer Recorded Date takes the slot — afterwards set the old video's 'Featured on Home Page' back to 'No' to keep things tidy.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Series Name
fields.description: Shown as the small tag on video cards, e.g. 'Hermeneutics Series'.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Speaker Name
fields.description: e.g. 'Dr. Charles Vance'

fields.name: role
fields.label: Role / Title
fields.description: e.g. 'Professor of Systematic Theology' (optional)

fields.name: category
fields.label: Category / Classification
fields.description: Pick the image's category. To add or remove options, open the 'Image Categories' collection in the left sidebar and create or delete a category.

fields.name: scripture
fields.label: Scripture Reference
fields.description: The related verse shown in the spotlight, e.g. "Romans 1:16".

fields.name: dateAdded
fields.label: Date Added
fields.description: The images with the newest Date Added fill the 'Bible Image Gallery Preview' on the home page.

fields.name: featured
fields.label: Featured Spotlight
fields.description: Set to 'Yes' to showcase this image in the spotlight at the top of the Bible Images page. Only one should be 'Yes' — if several are marked, the newest Date Added wins.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Category Name
fields.description: Shown on image cards and in the gallery filter, e.g. 'Manuscript'.

fields.name: announcementText
fields.label: Announcement Bar Message
fields.description: Main message on the announcement bar at the top of this page. Each page keeps its own copy of the bar text.

fields.name: announcementSubtext
fields.label: Announcement Bar Zoom Text (clickable)
fields.description: This text becomes the clickable Zoom link on the bar. The link itself is NOT set on this page: go to Seminars & Zoom > Featured Meeting Card > Zoom Meeting Link. Changing it there updates every page.

fields.name: badgeText
fields.label: Hero Badge Text
fields.description: Pill badge at top of hero (e.g. PREMIUM DIGITAL BIBLE LIBRARY & SCHOLARLY ARCHIVE)

fields.name: headingLine1
fields.label: Heading Line 1 (Bold Blue)
fields.description: First line in bold blue sans-serif typography (e.g. Unveiling the Depth of)

fields.name: headingLine2
fields.label: Heading Line 2 (Gold Script)
fields.description: Second line in elegant gold handwritten script typography (e.g. Holy Scripture)

fields.name: headline
fields.label: Combined Headline (Fallback)
fields.description: Legacy combined title fallback

fields.name: dailyVerses
fields.label: Daily Verses (Day 1 – 31)
fields.description: Add one entry per day of the month. The website shows the entry matching today's date (India time, switching at 12:00 AM) and repeats every month. Edit any entry at any time to change that day.

fields.name: verse
fields.label: Fallback Verse Text
fields.description: Shown only when no Daily Verse exists for any day.

fields.name: featuredLessons
fields.label: Featured Lessons Section
fields.description: The lessons in this section are chosen per lesson: open a lesson in 'Bible Lessons', set 'Featured on Home Page' to Yes, and pick a position (1-3). This block only controls the section heading.

fields.name: latestReferences
fields.label: Latest Bible References Section
fields.description: This section automatically shows the 2 scripture references with the newest 'Date Added'. Set it on each document in 'Scripture References'. This block only controls the section heading.

fields.name: featuredVideos
fields.label: Featured Bible Videos Section
fields.description: The videos in this section are chosen per video: open a video in 'Video Lectures', set 'Featured on Home Page' to Yes, and pick a position (1-3). This block only controls the section heading.

fields.name: galleryPreview
fields.label: Gallery Preview Section
fields.description: This section automatically shows the newest images by 'Date Added'. Set it on each document in 'Sacred Images'. This block only controls the section heading.

fields.name: featuredPublications
fields.label: Featured Publications Section
fields.description: Books and magazines are chosen per document: set Featured to Yes and pick a position (1-2). This block only controls the section heading.

fields.name: address
fields.label: Google Maps Address (Fallback)
fields.description: Used only when no Share Link is set. Type the address or place name to show on the map, e.g. "123 Church St, Springfield" — a live Google Map appears automatically, no API key needed.

fields.name: addressText
fields.label: Map Caption Text
fields.description: Optional caption shown below the map, e.g. the formatted address.

fields.name: featuredMeeting
fields.label: Featured Meeting Card
fields.description: The next live seminar. This is the single source of truth: it feeds this page, the Zoom banner at the bottom of the home page, and the announcement bar link across the whole site. Update it here once and all three stay in sync.

fields.name: time
fields.label: Time
fields.description: Include the time zone, e.g. '7:00 PM IST' or '7:00 PM - 8:30 PM EST'. Times without a zone are read as India time (IST). Used to decide which seminar is next and when it shows as Live.

fields.name: zoomUrl

fields.description: Paste the full Zoom link here (it must start with https:// and be a zoom.us link). It powers the Join Meeting button on this page, the Join button on the home page Zoom banner, AND the clickable Zoom text on the announcement bar at the top of every page.
